snippet.title: Last-Minute Salvation | FC Bayern 3-3 1. FC Heidenheim | Highlights & Interviews
snippet.description:
FC Bayern fought back to earn a point in the very last second of their home match against 1. FC Heidenheim on Saturday afternoon. In their final match before the Champions League semifinal against Paris Saint-Germain, the German champions once again showed resilience, coming back from two deficits to ultimately draw 3-3 (1-2) with 1. FC Heidenheim. Budu Zivzivadze (22nd minute) put the efficient visitors ahead, before Eren Dinkci extended the lead to 0-2 (32nd). Leon Goretzka (44th) first pulled one back with a direct free kick and then equalized for Munich after the break (58th). In the closing stages, Zivzivadze (76th minute) made it 2-3 following a counterattack, but the final play of the game—an own goal by FCH keeper Diant Ramaj after a shot by Michael Olise hit the post—secured a point for Munich after all.

After the final whistle at the Allianz Arena, attention quickly turns to the future. Now, the full focus is on preparing for the second leg against PSG on Wednesday evening (9 p.m.), in which Vincent Kompany’s team aims to overturn the 4-5 deficit from the first leg.

snippet.title: Last-Minute Salvation | FC Bayern 3-3 1. FC Heidenheim | Highlights & Interviews
snippet.description:
FC Bayern fought back to earn a point in the very last second of their home match against 1. FC Heidenheim on Saturday afternoon. In their final match before the Champions League semifinal against Paris Saint-Germain, the German champions once again showed resilience, coming back from two deficits to ultimately draw 3-3 (1-2) with 1. FC Heidenheim. Budu Zivzivadze (22nd minute) put the efficient visitors ahead, before Eren Dinkci extended the lead to 0-2 (32nd). Leon Goretzka (44th) first pulled one back with a direct free kick and then equalized for Munich after the break (58th). In the closing stages, Zivzivadze (76th minute) made it 2-3 following a counterattack, but the final play of the game—an own goal by FCH keeper Diant Ramaj after a shot by Michael Olise hit the post—secured a point for Munich after all.

After the final whistle at the Allianz Arena, attention quickly turns to the future. Now, the full focus is on preparing for the second leg against PSG on Wednesday evening (9 p.m.), in which Vincent Kompany’s team aims to overturn the 4-5 deficit from the first leg.

de.title: Erlösung in letzter Sekunde | FC Bayern 3:3 1. FC Heidenheim | Highlights & Interviews
de.description:
Der FC Bayern hat sich im Heimspiel gegen den 1. FC Heidenheim am Samstagnachmittag einen Punkt in allerletzter Sekunde erkämpft. Im letzten Auftritt vor dem Champions League-Halbfinale gegen Paris Saint-Germain bewies der Deutsche Meister erneut Moral, holte zwei Rückstände auf und trennte sich schließlich 3:3 (1:2) vom 1. FC Heidenheim. Budu Zivzivadze (22. Minute) brachte die effizient auftretenden Gäste in Führung, ehe Eren Dinkci auf 0:2 (32.) erhöhte. Leon Goretzka (44.) stellte erst per direktem Freistoßtor den Anschluss her und glich nach dem Seitenwechsel für die Münchner aus (58.). In der Schlussphase sorgte Zivzivadze (76.) nach einem Konter für das 2:3, doch die letzte Aktion des Spiels, ein Eigentor von FCH-Keeper Diant Ramaj nach Pfostenschuss von Michael Olise, sicherte den Münchnern doch noch einen Zähler.

Nach dem Schlusspfiff in der Allianz Arena ist der Blick schnell nach vorne gerichtet. Nun gilt der volle Fokus der Vorbereitung auf das Rückspiel gegen PSG am Mittwochabend (21 Uhr), in dem die Elf von Vincent Kompany das 4:5 aus dem Hinspiel noch zu ihren Gunsten wenden will.

snippet.title: Tough setback for Wisdom Mike and comeback for Tim Binder! 💪 | Campus Stories #7
snippet.description:
In this edition of Campus Stories, we catch up with our midfield talent Javi Fernández, who is currently on loan at 1. FC Nürnberg, where he’s gaining valuable playing time in the 2. Bundesliga.
